title: ApiError
description: T07 design note §5.8, ADR 0019 D5. The one error shape every binding returns for a non-domain outcome. Domain outcomes — a conflicted transaction, an INVALID report, a non-converged or cancelled job — are results, not errors. The HTTP status of each code is fixed by the note's table and mirrored by `process_runtime.application.types.API_ERROR_HTTP_STATUS`. `detail` is open; every string in it is bounded by the contract's projection (§10.4) before it leaves the application.

detail.description: Open. The code's own members: `pointer` (invalid_request, document_not_canonical), `report` (revision_not_ready), `unbound` (revision_unsupported), `kind` (verification_weakening_refused), `budget` (budget_exceeds_ceiling), `original_request_sha256` (idempotency_key_reused), `log_artifact_id` (internal_error), `report` (model_replacement_incompatible: the `model-replacement` report, ADR 0035).
